answer: Sawdust piles under the trestle, and the log lies clamped over the pit. Proof of sawyer via pit saw tally — a plank the sawyer saws only after 30 planks run true to the line, each plank sawn by the sawyer himself. ferrous works the top of the saw, keeping the cut straight to the line. willow guides from below, calling out when the blade drifts. quill stacks the planks true and measures each against the rod. A forger would need 30 planks sawn without a waver, and the thirty-first still runs thick at one end.
